_doc: Known auction-house / seller origin locations, used by estimate_inbound_shipping.py to quote inbound freight to 47725 when a lot says the seller ships but does not price it. Only add an entry when the location was actually read off a lot or seller page -- a guessed ZIP produces a confidently wrong landed cost.

America's Thrift Supply.evidence: Shipping policy page (americasthriftsupply.com/policies/shipping-policy): 'All items from America's Thrift Supply are shipped from our warehouse located in Birmingham, Alabama' via FedEx, 3-5 business day processing. No exact street address published, so the ZIP is city-center Birmingham, not a verified warehouse ZIP -- the storefront JSON has no shipping-rate endpoint (real-time rates require a live cart/checkout session, which the read-only CLI does not create), so shipping must be estimated via estimate_inbound_shipping.py instead of read directly.
